method: Whole-source visual inspection. Mounted figures use tire-plane center; slam figures use standing/crouched boot support. Anatomical scale from the standing overhead-lift rider only; motorcycle and raised arms excluded. Hair-to-sole measurement approximate where the motorcycle overlaps the crown.
review: Eight static mounted views S/SW/W/NW/N/NE/E/SE plus four whole-figure ground-slam S phases. Silver-white hair, silver-white physical armor with thin red fissures, clean warm skin and dark-red eyes. These static riding poses do not cover mounted stop/idle cycles.
